FunctionInput_domo_uploadstreamdatapart.description: One ordered stream execution part, supplied as headerless rows of lexical cell text.

id.description: Execution identifier returned by the part upload.

partId.description: Part identifier used for this upload; acknowledgement is not a row-level import result.

createdAt.description: Execution creation instant in UTC.

startedAt.description: Execution start instant in UTC, if reported.

updatedAt.description: Execution modification instant in UTC.

currentState.description: Execution state returned after accepting the part, not a commit guarantee.

FunctionOutput_domo_uploadstreamdatapart.description: Upload acknowledgement and execution metadata; this does not confirm row validation or committed ingestion.

tags.instructions: First use `create-stream-execution`. Supply rows in the DataSet's column order and an increasing part ID distinct from other parts. Keep track of part IDs; retry a failed upload using the same intended part before committing. At most 1,000 rows and 1 MiB of serialized UTF-8 CSV per call. This stages data only; use `commit-stream-execution` after every intended part is uploaded.

functions.name: upload-task-attachment
functions.description: Upload file bytes as a new attachment to a task and return the attachment metadata.

taskId.description: Task ID to receive the attachment.

fileName.description: File name to associate with the uploaded bytes, preserving Unicode.

mimeType.description: MIME media type for the file bytes, such as application/pdf.

contentBase64.description: Standard padded base64 of exact file bytes; decoded content must be at most 5 MiB (5,242,880 bytes), a provisional tool bound.

FunctionInput_domo_uploadtaskattachment.description: One task attachment with its exact file bytes encoded as standard base64.

id.description: Opaque ID of the new attachment.

createdAt.description: Creation instant in UTC when interpretable.

createdBy.description: Domo user ID of the uploader.

FunctionOutput_domo_uploadtaskattachment.description: Metadata establishing creation of the task attachment, not scanning or delivery.

tags.instructions: Get matching task IDs from `list-tasks`. Supply exact file bytes as base64 with a file name and media type; this is a binary transfer, not a text description. Maximum decoded file size is provisionally 5 MiB. Repeating the call can add another attachment. Use `download-task-attachment` to retrieve an existing file.
